Logger middlewarePer-thread, per-second cache of the formatted common/combined log timestamp; formatting the clock is avoided on every request (audit MWA-003).Returns the common/combined log timestamp, formatted once per wall-clock second and reused per thread.Escapes control characters, quotes, and backslashes so the value stays safe for line-oriented log output.Creates middleware that logs each request at the given MiddlewareLogLevel threshold.Creates middleware that logs each request using the given MiddlewareLogFormat style.

proc sanitizeLogField(value: string): string {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Escapes bytes that can break line-oriented log parsers. U+2028/U+2029 are multi-byte UTF-8 (0xE2 0x80 0xA8/0xA9) so they are matched on the raw byte sequence without altering behaviour for any other input.
